notes.title: Free Game Wednesday: take a look at the great twin-stick Cecconoid
notes.notes:
Cecconoid, a fantastic twin-stick shooter with small cramped environments where the screen flicks between each section actually released the source code and now you can play free.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/free-game-wednesday-take-a-look-at-the-great-twin-stick-cecconoid

notes.title: Patch Fix: 30.07.2020
notes.notes:
Cecconoid has been patched to fix a race condition when hitting pause, while transition levels. 

Happy shooting!

notes.title: Cecconoid Update: 17.07.2020
notes.notes:
Cecconoid has been updated: 

[list]
[*] Fixed Eugatron bug, where dying on the last enemy would stop level transition, blocking progress
[*] Fixed door collision in Cecconoid
[*] Added keyboard bindings to support IJKL (right stick) on some MAME compatible controllers
[*] Upgraded to latest Unity LTS version
[*] Updated InControl to latest version, for compatibility improvements
[/list]

This build is now live on the test and default branches. Happy zapping!

notes.title: Cecconoid's Released!
notes.notes:
Happy birthday Cecconoid! 

To celebrate, early birds can grab the game at 15% off, for launch week. Enjoy!
